wins: Mapped external perimeter with rapid nmap sweeps, capturing consistent service fingerprints for prioritized hosts.
Captured initial credentials via brute forcing the exposed authentication portal, enabling further internal reconnaissance.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after obtaining low-privilege shell due to missing vulnerable binaries and limited sudo rights.
Lacked persistence mechanism after the C2 channel was detected and killed, nullifying the foothold.
key_outcomes.summary: Run gathered strong reconnaissance intel and initial access but stalled at post-exploitation due to privilege escalation and persistence gaps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-access privilege escalation attempts consistently fail because sudo rights are denied and no local exploits are present.

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration reveals open ports 22 or 3389 with default banners
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted enumeration with nmap scripting engine to gather credentials/encryption details

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web authentication portal is reachable with valid usernames
skill_cards.then_action: Launch hydra password spraying using captured username list and identify weak credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When low-privilege shell is obtained without sudo rights
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SUID binaries and kernel version for manual escalation or exploit matches

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in early reconnaissance using nmap NSE scripts led to actionable credential evidence.
Hydra spray reliably produced valid initial credentials during the run.

next_experiments.title: Integrate sudo filtering with enumeration
next_experiments.description: After pulling low-privilege shell, immediately enumerate sudo capabilities and available binaries to rule out privilege escalation opportunities before manual exploit search.

next_experiments.title: Automate persistence discovery
next_experiments.description: Deploy automated scripts (e.g., bloodhound+custom service fiber) to search for writable cron/systemd units once a foothold is established.

next_experiments.title: Blend credential reuse with lateral scanning
next_experiments.description: When credentials are captured, automatically feed them into internal SMB/SSH scans to expand lateral reach before C2 detection.
